decision_rule: Construct a near-boundary matched-history surface where wrong matched history, not only reset or zero-current response, measurably reduces clearance, success, or mitigation outcome.
failure_criteria: wrong matched history remains outcome-neutral after boundary relocation
accepted rows are no longer matched in current response and scene
normal history is already colliding or invalid
the construction uses hidden parameters or oracle labels as actor inputs
hypothesis: M114 finds reset/zero-current near-boundary rows but no wrong-history rows. Tightening obstacle geometry around matched pairs may expose wrong-history causal outcome differences that passive M113 continuations missed.
success_criteria: M111/M113 matched pairs are replayed under a boundary-tightened or relocated obstacle configuration
accepted rows require normal valid continuation and wrong-history margin loss or mitigation degradation
reset/zero-current rows are reported separately from wrong-history rows
the result decides whether to train a wrong-history outcome intervention objective
